title: CAPYBARA COVE IS OPEN
body:
The floating cliffs of Capybara Cove are officially open to visitors!

Wander the grass ledges, poke the mossy rocks, and say hello to Yuzu, the resident capybara. Every object in this world can be clicked — a few of them even talk back.

New notices are pinned to this board whenever something happens in the Cove.

title: SKY LANTERN FESTIVAL
body:
When the sun dips behind the far mesa, every lantern on the cliff is lit at once.

Switch the world to DUSK or NIGHT with the time button in the top-right corner to watch the lanterns glow and the fireflies come out.

Bring warm bread. Yuzu insists.

title: WORLD UPDATE 1.4 — WINDY CLIFFS
body:
PATCH NOTES

+ Added drifting parallax cloud layers
+ Grass now sways in the wind
+ Tree canopies react to gusts
+ Fireflies added to the night cycle
+ Capybara blink animation restored
- Removed one (1) suspiciously square cloud

title: LOST & FOUND CHEST
body:
A wooden chest washed up on the eastern ledge. So far it contains:

- three acorns
- a slightly damp map
- someone's left boot

If any of this belongs to you, click the chest and shout. Yuzu will pretend not to hear you.

title: BUILD YOUR OWN LEDGE
body:
Applications are open for a plot on the second floating island.

Requirements:
1. A tolerance for heights
2. At least one plant
3. Willingness to feed a capybara

Speak to the signpost near the campfire to register your interest.
